name: Salmah
role: Watch retainer sponsored by Tun Hasan
bio: Salmah answers to Hasan’s household. When a messenger asks her to leave a merchant’s warehouse for the town watch, she wants someone to sign for the goods she leaves behind.
notes: fact: Pires places the city watch under the temenggung and distinguishes it from the laksamana’s role at sea (Pires II, pp. 264–265; port-labour.md §2)
inference: Retainers around officials support patron-based service, not a fixed establishment of port guards (port-labour.md §2; Andaya pp. 90–91)
gameplay: Salmah, her patron link and the reassignment are fictional (port-labour.md §4)
